- [LFAC.2.5.2] **Adapter-side (optional efficiency):**
  adapters may additionally suppress no-op updates at the
  source-system boundary to reduce wire traffic and
  engine load. Not required for correctness — the
  engine's dedup is the contract. Adapters that suppress
  aggressively emit less (entity adapters comparing against
  last-emitted state; message-bus adapters dropping identical
  republishes; polling adapters dropping unchanged
  refreshes); adapters that pass everything through let
  the engine do the work. Adapter-specific documentation
  describes what each adapter chooses to do.
